description: Image text (OCR). Send an image URL or base64 (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 5 MB and 8000 px a side); returns the text in reading order, one line per line, and with layout on, where each line sits in the image, plus truncated when the text ran past the reply limit. Use for screenshots, receipts, signs and scanned pages. Not for PDFs that have a text layer (use /v1/pdf-text) or for describing pictures. Typical response 2 to 6 s. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.01 (USDC, x402).

image_base64.description: The image as base64, up to 5 MB decoded. Send image_url or image_base64.

image_url.description: Public http or https URL of a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image.

layout.description: Also return each line with where it sits in the image, such as top-left.
